profile_text.body:
Shopify Inc. is a public company headquartered in Ottawa, traded under the ticker SHOP, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001594805. Its site describes it as an all-in-one commerce platform for businesses, offering more than ecommerce software, with tools to manage every part of a business and a free trial.

The company positions AI as central to that platform. It says businesses can build or grow quickly with AI, get discovered across AI channels, and let shoppers check out directly in a chat without the merchant taking any action. It attributes this to Agentic Storefronts.
